title: CES
metaDescription: CES: verified dates, venue and practical planning context for this technology event.
venue: Las Vegas Convention Center and Venetian Expo

overview.about: CES in Las Vegas is the world's most influential consumer-technology show, where the industry unveils the products and ideas that will shape the year ahead. Run by the Consumer Technology Association each January, it fills the city with everything from TVs and cars to robotics and AI.
overview.nextEvent: The next CES is held in January across the Las Vegas Convention Center and surrounding venues. Thousands of exhibitors, from global giants to startups, use it to launch products and set the tech agenda for the year.

@graph.name: CES
@graph.description: CES is the Consumer Technology Association’s annual trade show, spread across multiple Las Vegas convention venues rather than a single exhibition hall. It is where manufacturers, retailers and media introduce consumer electronics ranging from televisions and vehicles to home technology. The 2027 dates cover four January show days; visitors need to match badges and appointments to the specific campus or hotel venue.

arrivalWindow: Arrive before 6 January if you need local check-in or opening-day access.
eventDayDetail: CES is dated 6 January 2027 – 9 January 2027; use that range when planning arrival, tickets and reminders.
airportTransfer: CES publishes shuttle options from Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) and between the LVCC and Venetian Expo; check the 2027 attendee transportation guide for the final operating days and times.
stayAreas: Convention Center area; North Strip; Venetian/Palazzo area; C Space / ARIA area
stayGuidance: The Convention Center area shortens the LVCC start, North Strip hotels connect through the Monorail or CES shuttles, Venetian/Palazzo is beside the Venetian Campus, and C Space / ARIA works when your programme is concentrated there.

stayAreaDetails.toVenue: About 5–15 minutes on foot or by the LVCC campus loop to the Las Vegas Convention Center halls.
About 10–25 minutes by Monorail or the official CES shuttle to LVCC; use Tech Express for the Venetian Campus.
About 5–10 minutes on foot to Venetian Expo; the Monorail does not serve Venetian Expo.
About 15–30 minutes by the official C Space shuttle or Las Vegas transport links to the LVCC and Venetian campuses.

transportDetail: Transport details for Las Vegas, United States can change by edition, so check local routing close to the event.
